svg.text: A load and a store through the LSU
Still frames, one per cycle; filled parts are active. Latencies measured, order inside a cycle inferred.
Virtual address bits the L1D path uses
3 clk to a pointer chase, 4 to an ALU, 5 to a SIMD register
2 per clk, address and data uops; 60 entry queue of 32 B slots
set 13:6 inside page offset → lookup before dTLB
c1 AGU; PC pair → wait; mispredict 25 clk
c2 bank 16 B; SQ CAM; dTLB
c4 ALU; c5 SIMD; late STA → replay
miss fetch ownership; younger hits write ahead
